Seven new photos (Gemini 2.5 Flash): five children playing at a singer, a police officer, a mechanic, a bus driver and a doctor; Ana's classroom with one girl standing up to answer; Diego painting at home. lesson.title: 3.14 I want to be an artist
lesson.unit_title: Meeting people and talking about them
lesson.unit_outcome: Introduce people and answer introductions, use the short forms of be, answer yes/no questions in short, compare ages, talk about languages, nationalities and jobs, describe people, say whose things are, give an address and say what you want to be.
lesson.lesson_title: I want to be an artist
lesson.sub_lesson_title: I want to be an artist
lesson.goal: Say what people want to be with want to be + a job (She wants to be a singer. / What do you want to be? I want to be an artist.).
lesson.grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 3.14 More Jobs: A1 says what someone's job is (He is a singer.); A1+ 3.14 says what someone wants to be. The one new grammar relationship is want(s) + to be + a/an + job (She wants to be a singer.), set against is + a job (She's a singer.) and against isn't (She isn't a doctor. She wants to be a doctor.); the question is What do you want to be? / What does she want to be?. Children play at A1's jobs in five new photos, Diego paints at home (he works in an office, 3.9), and in Ana's classroom 2.12's Stand up and Sit down come back with the question.
lesson.prerequisite: A1 3.14 jobs; A1 4.5 want; A1+ 2.12 Stand up and Sit down; A1+ 3.4 isn't; A1+ 3.9 What do you do?
lesson.speaking_outcome: Join want to be (WAN-tuh-bee); stress the job. Do not require native-like speed.
